access.note: Consumer product is free/self-serve with a Google account. No public API for the consumer product; Google only documents Gemini Notebook Enterprise APIs (Preview) behind Google Cloud/Gemini Enterprise access.

api.note: No official public API for the consumer NotebookLM. Google documents a Preview API only for Gemini Notebook Enterprise (create/list notebooks, manage sources, audio overviews). Community MCP servers (e.g. notebooklm-mcp, notebooklm-mcp-server) reverse-engineer the private endpoints.

buildability.blocker: No official self-serve API key for the consumer product; only enterprise-gated Gemini Notebook Enterprise preview APIs. Community access relies on undocumented reverse-engineered endpoints and session auth that can break.

research_notes: Google AI Developers Forum and AutoContent API 2026 status confirm no consumer public API. Google Cloud docs confirm Gemini Notebook Enterprise API is in Preview. Community MCP servers (PleasePrompto/notebooklm-mcp ~3.2k stars; moodRobotics/notebooklm-mcp-server) require Google session/cookie auth, not a documented public API.

name: Otter AI
one_line: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings with real-time notes, action items, and enterprise search.

access.note: Public REST API is available only to Enterprise workspaces and requires contacting your Otter account manager to enable. MCP server is OAuth-based and works from a normal account, but the underlying API surface is enterprise-gated.

api.note: Documented Public API (api.otter.ai/v1) covers channels, conversations, transcripts, action items, insights, workspace details, and webhooks. Bearer-token API keys created in the Developer tab. Official hosted MCP server at mcp.otter.ai/mcp (OAuth).

buildability.blocker: Public API requires an Enterprise workspace and account-manager approval; not available on self-serve or free tiers. Community MCPs that bypass this use unofficial email/password endpoints.

research_notes: Official help center documents the Public API (Enterprise only, Bearer key auth) and an official OAuth MCP server. Otter's own blog (2025-10-10) confirms MCP. Note: separate unrelated companies (otterab.com, tryotter.com) also brand 'Otter' but are restaurant-POS products, not Otter.ai.

name: Fathom
one_line: AI meeting notetaker that records, transcribes, and summarizes calls in real time and syncs action items and notes to CRMs.

access.note: Free-forever consumer tier plus paid plans. API keys are self-serve from User Settings (API Access section); OAuth available for building public apps for other Fathom users.

api.note: Well-documented REST API (developers.fathom.ai, api.fathom.ai/external/v1) covering meetings, recordings, transcripts, summaries, action items, teams, webhooks, plus TypeScript/Python SDKs. Official hosted MCP server at api.fathom.ai/mcp with docs at developers.fathom.ai/mcp-docs.

research_notes: developers.fathom.ai confirms self-serve X-Api-Key auth, OAuth for public apps, and an official MCP server (verified live). Multiple third-party MCP wrappers also exist (Dot-Fun/fathom-mcp, agencyenterprise/fathom-mcp-server). Note: 'Fathom' here is Fathom.fm/video the meeting notetaker, not Fathom Analytics or Fathom flood-risk.

name: Consensus
one_line: AI-powered academic search engine that returns and synthesizes answers grounded in 200M+ peer-reviewed research papers.

access.note: REST API is application-only ('Request access', limited availability, ~$0.10/call plus platform fee, expect a response within a week). Keys are managed from the API & MCP dashboard; the MCP endpoint is OAuth-enabled for self-serve users with plan-based call limits.

api.note: Documented v1 Search/quick_search REST endpoint (docs.consensus.app, api.consensus.app) returning top papers with metadata and relevance scores. Official hosted MCP server at mcp.consensus.app/mcp (OAuth, or Bearer API key for enterprise).

buildability.blocker: REST API keys require an application/approval process and paid per-call pricing; not guaranteed self-serve. The official MCP endpoint is more open (OAuth) but shares the same monthly call pool with plan limits.

research_notes: Official help center documents key creation, x-api-key header, and shared API/MCP usage limits; API landing and subscription pages confirm application-only access. docs.consensus.app documents the MCP server URL mcp.consensus.app/mcp. Note: goconsensus.com is a separate sales-demo company with its own API.

name: Reducto
one_line: Agentic document platform that parses, extracts, classifies, splits, and edits complex documents (PDFs, DOCX, etc.) into LLM-ready JSON.

access.note: Self-serve signup with 15,000 free credits on the Standard plan, then credit-based pricing (~$0.015/credit). API keys generated in Reducto Studio; enterprise/VPC options available.

api.note: Fully documented REST API (docs.reducto.ai) with OpenAPI specs: parse, extract, classify, split, edit, async processing with webhooks, plus official Python/Node/Go SDKs and a CLI. Official MCP server (github.com/reductoai/mcp-server-reducto, hosted at mcp.reducto.ai).

research_notes: reducto.ai/developers and docs.reducto.ai confirm the API surface, SDKs, CLI, and MCP server; quickstart documents API-key auth (REDUCTO_API_KEY). Official GitHub org reductoai hosts the MCP server repo and SDKs.

name: Devin
one_line: Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer that plans, writes, tests, and ships code across cloud sessions, CLI, desktop, and API.

access.note: Sign up at app.devin.ai; API/MCP access requires a paid Devin account and generating credentials (service-user keys or personal access tokens, cog_ prefix). Enterprise tier adds RBAC and multi-org controls.

api.note: Extensive documented REST API v3 (docs.devin.ai, api.devin.ai/v3) for sessions, playbooks, knowledge, secrets, schedules, insights, and enterprise analytics, with published OpenAPI specs. Official Devin MCP server at mcp.devin.ai/mcp (API key auth); DeepWiki MCP also official and free.

research_notes: Verified docs.devin.ai/api-reference/authentication (principal+token model, cog_ keys, Bearer auth) and docs.devin.ai/work-with-devin/devin-mcp (official MCP server, mcp.devin.ai/mcp, requires API key). OpenAPI specs published at docs.devin.ai/v1/v2/v3-openapi.yaml. Community MCP wrappers also exist (e.g. kazuph/mcp-devin).

name: higgsfield
one_line: AI video and image generation platform (DoP, Soul, Seedream, Kling, Seedance models) with a unified asynchronous generative-media API.

access.note: Self-serve signup; API credentials (key ID + secret) are created in Higgsfield Cloud (cloud.higgsfield.ai) and API usage is billed separately from app subscriptions on a credit/usage basis.

api.note: Documented REST API (docs.higgsfield.ai, platform.higgsfield.ai) for image, video, audio, and 3D generation with submit/poll/cancel/webhook lifecycle, plus official Python (higgsfield-client) and TypeScript (@higgsfield/client) SDKs. No official or notable MCP server found.

research_notes: Verified docs.higgsfield.ai authentication (Authorization: Key KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET, legacy hf-api-key/hf-secret headers) and quickstart (platform.higgsfield.ai endpoints). Official SDK repos confirmed under github.com/higgsfield-ai. No MCP server found in official docs or registries.

name: Mermaid CLI
one_line: Open-source CLI (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions into SVG, PNG, or PDF files using headless Chromium/Puppeteer.

access.note: Open-source (MIT), free to install and run locally via npm, Docker/Podman, or npx; no accounts or credentials required.

api.note: Not a hosted API service; it is a command-line tool with an exposed Node.js API (run() in @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli, not covered by semver). Documentation lives in the GitHub README. No MCP server found.

research_notes: Official mermaid-js/mermaid-cli README and npm page confirm CLI usage (mmdc -i/-o), Node.js API, Docker/brew/npx installs, and MIT license. Auth is not applicable (local tool).

name: YouTube Transcript
one_line: Open-source Python library and CLI (youtube-transcript-api) that fetches video transcripts/subtitles from YouTube without an API key.

access.note: Open-source (MIT) on GitHub/PyPI; no API key or account required. Optional proxy credentials (e.g. Webshare residential proxies) are supported to work around IP bans.

api.note: Not an official vendor API: it uses YouTube's undocumented web-client endpoint. Provides a Python API, CLI, and JSON/formatter outputs with translation support. No MCP server found.

buildability.blocker: Relies on undocumented YouTube endpoints; risk of RequestBlocked/IpBlocked errors and breaking whenever YouTube changes internals, with no official Google API backing.

research_notes: jdepoix/youtube-transcript-api README explicitly states no API key or headless browser needed and that it uses an undocumented part of the YouTube API; IP-ban and proxy guidance is documented in-repo. MIT license, ~8k stars.

name: Grain
one_line: AI notetaker that records, transcribes, and clips video meetings, exposing recordings, highlights, AI notes, and webhooks via API and MCP.

access.note: Personal API access on Starter/Business/Enterprise plans; Workspace API access on Business/Enterprise (admin-generated). Free plan has no API access. MCP uses OAuth against your Grain account.

api.note: Documented public API v2 (developers.grain.com, api.grain.com, versioned via Public-Api-Version header) covering recordings, transcripts, highlights, AI summaries/action items, teams, meeting types, uploads, and webhooks. Official Grain MCP server at api.grain.com/_/mcp (OAuth).

research_notes: developers.grain.com documents OAuth2 token endpoint, Personal/Workspace Access Tokens, rate limits (300 req/min), and the v2 API versioning. Support articles confirm the official MCP server (developers.grain.com/mcp) and plan requirements for API access.
